additional_context: Small hosted product smoke: use direct repository editing, measure and deliver one genuine improvement. Do not invoke a large evolutionary search or change benchmark data.

entrypoints.description: Fixed synthetic 20000 event corpus, 1500 allowed IDs, four repeats; complete process timing

correctness_constraints: Exact output equality, order and duplicate preservation; same original event objects; no input mutation.
Keep tests and fixed benchmark unchanged; standard-library Python with string user IDs.
objective.description: Minimize complete process elapsed time on the fixed synthetic event-filter workload. Preserve selected event order, duplicates, object identity and unchanged input.

scope.notes: Optimize only event_filter.py. Preserve frozen tests and .fleet benchmark. Include only unchanged, Fleet-generated .evo setup metadata needed to reproduce the experiment; it is not an optimization target.

testability.expectations: Run frozen tests and benchmark, then paired baseline/candidate measurements on the same selected Mac execution device.
known_gaps: Synthetic delivery smoke test, not representative customer production data.
